site.lead: I run a Proxmox homelab behind CGNAT, which I segmented, secured and monitor myself, and I've broken and fixed most of it along the way. Now looking for an entry-level IT role, remote or on-site, with a long-term focus on systems and security.
site.motd: Welcome to doof.quest — uptime > ego. logs > guesses.

projects.title: password-manager
projects.blurb: DOOF Vault: a terminal password manager rebuilt around a threat model. Argon2id, HKDF and AES-256-GCM, decrypt on demand, 271 tests and checksummed releases.

projects.title: net-health-monitor
projects.blurb: Dashboard for ping, DNS lookups and port checks across hosts, with local AI diagnostic summaries. Rate limiting, host blacklist and input validation built in.

about: I'm Maverick, a graduating BS Information Technology student at the University of San Carlos in Cebu, Philippines.

Linux is what got me started. Then I wanted to run my own services and secure my own network, mostly because I wanted to know where my data was going. That turned into doof, a Proxmox server at home with its own VLANs, monitoring and a Cloudflare tunnel, since my ISP doesn't give me a public IP. A lot of what I know came from breaking it and figuring out why.
I'm looking for an entry-level IT role, remote or on-site. Long term I want to work in systems and security.
When I'm not at a keyboard, I'm usually playing sports, doing yoga or out hiking.
